about.title: A 50-Year Legacy of Precision
about.subtitle: Guiding Careers Since 1994
about.text: Welcome to Shree Venkateshwara Institute of Commerce. Established in 1975, our institution has stood as a foundational milestone for commercial and technical excellence in Chikkamagaluru. For over three decades under our current administration, we have cultivated a disciplined environment optimized for speed, accuracy, confidence, and state examination success.

legacy.title: A respected commerce institute built on discipline, practice, and results.
legacy.text: For generations, Shree Venkateshwara Institute of Commerce has guided students in typewriting, shorthand, and practical computer skills through patient instruction, structured practice, and examination-focused preparation. From Chikkamagaluru, our students move forward with confidence, certification, and career-ready discipline.

results.title: Built to excel in Karnataka, batch after batch.
results.text: The institute is shaped around careful practice, strict evaluation, and steady mentoring so students can perform with speed and accuracy when the examination clock starts.
results.focusText: Highlighting the institute's consistent commitment to complete student success.
results.excellenceText: A reputation built on precision training, examination discipline, and long-term student outcomes.
results.certificateText: Typing, shorthand, and computer examinations are conducted by KSEAB. After successful completion, students receive government certificates that can support applications for eligible government career opportunities as per official notifications.

courses.title: Courses that turn practice into employable confidence.
courses.intro: Every stream is designed for real examination performance and practical workplace use.
descriptions: KSEAB Junior and Senior typewriting exam preparation. Students begin at Junior level and progress to Senior after passing, with structured Kannada and English typing practice.
KSEAB Junior, Intermediate, and Senior shorthand exam preparation. Students begin at Junior level and move forward after passing, with training available in both Kannada and English.
Computer Education includes Office Automation and Graphic Designing exam preparation. After completing Office Automation, students become eligible to continue into Graphic Designing.
Students who complete and pass Office Automation can move into the Graphic Designing course for creative software, layout, and design-focused computer skills.

faq.title: Clear answers before you visit.
faq.text: The most common admission questions are handled here, while course-specific guidance is best confirmed with the institute directly.

items.question: How do I confirm current fees for a course?
items.answer: Fees can vary by course level, batch, and examination pathway. Please call the admissions desk for the latest fee details.

items.question: What batch timings are available for students and working candidates?
items.answer: Batch timings are planned around student convenience and exam preparation schedules. Morning, evening, or special practice slots may be available depending on the active course.

items.question: Are the typewriting and shorthand courses government recognised?
items.answer: Typing, shorthand, and computer examination pathways are connected with KSEAB certification processes. The institute will guide students on eligible levels, exam forms, and official requirements.

items.question: Can beginners join without prior typing or computer experience?
items.answer: Yes. Beginners can start with foundational practice and progress through speed, accuracy, mock tests, and exam-format preparation under instructor guidance.
